name: Yeon-Hwan Seon
source: Seon is the CEO and founder of the company. Formerly a lawyer, he developed a taste in finance and business. He is the only person at the company who gets called by his surname, as a running joke. He is an idealistic boss who wishes to break-free from the corporate world's unhealthy work culture, hence his caring treatment of his employees.
